newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil May 21-31 IGP-M inflation index up 0.38 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil May 21-31 IGP-M inflation index up 0.38 pct.

text.p: Brazil's IGP-M inflation index rose 0.38 percent between May 21 and May 31, compared with a 0.02 percent drop between April 21 and April 30, the Getulio Vargas Foudation (FGV) said.

The IGP-M is composed of three economic indicators: the IPA wholesale price index, which rose 0.09 percent in the period; the IPC consumer price index, which advanced 0.72 percent; and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 0.75 percent.
The IPA has a 60 percent weighting, the IPC a 30 percent weighting and the INCC 10 percent, the FGV said.
The IGP-M index, which measures inflation over 10-day intervals, is published by the independent research institute Fundacao Getulio Vargas (FGV).
